cd /app
python - <<'PY'
import os,sys,subprocess,shlex,re
from pathlib import Path
url='https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZCbvyPbhRfA'
# ensure yt-dlp
subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-m','pip','-q','install','yt-dlp'],check=True)
# download subtitles auto and video metadata
subprocess.run(['yt-dlp','--skip-download','--write-auto-subs','--sub-langs','en','--sub-format','vtt','-o','zork.%(ext)s',url],check=True)
# find vtt
vtts=list(Path('/app').glob('zork*.en.vtt'))
if not vtts:
    print('NO_VTT')
    sys.exit(2)
vtt=vtts[0]
text=vtt.read_text(errors='ignore')
# extract caption lines
lines=[]
for ln in text.splitlines():
    if '-->' in ln or ln.strip()=='' or ln.startswith('WEBVTT') or ln.strip().isdigit():
        continue
    ln=re.sub(r'<[^>]+>','',ln)
    ln=ln.replace(' ',' ').strip()
    if ln:
        lines.append(ln)
full='\n'.join(lines)
Path('/app/transcript_raw.txt').write_text(full)
print('VTT',vtt)
print('LINES',len(lines))
PY
ls -l /app | sed -n '1,120p'
